page.title: Routines
page.description: Agent tasks that run on a schedule, inside the permissions you give them.
page.descriptionOn: Agent tasks on {{host}} that run on a schedule, inside the permissions you give them.
page.descriptionThisMac: Agent tasks on this Mac that run on a schedule, inside the permissions you give them.
page.descriptionThisComputer: Agent tasks on this computer that run on a schedule, inside the permissions you give them.
page.descriptionAll: Agent tasks on every host that run on a schedule, inside the permissions you give them.
page.emptyDescription: A routine sends a prompt to an agent on a schedule, each run in a session of its own, while Kettu is open.
page.unreadableTitle: Your routines could not be read
page.unreadable: routines.json was set aside as {{backup}}, so nothing is lost. New routines work as usual.
page.unreadableGone: Kettu starts with an empty list.
page.loadFailed: The routines could not be loaded.
page.footnote: Routines only run while Kettu is open. A routine pauses when its agent is within 10% of a plan limit.

examples.heading: Start from an example
examples.hint: Opens New routine with these filled in. Nothing runs until you create it.

triage.name: Morning triage
triage.prompt: Summarize the issues and pull requests opened or updated since the last run, and flag anything urgent.

tests.name: Nightly test sweep
tests.prompt: Run the full test suite and explain each failure with its likely cause.

dependencies.name: Dependency audit
dependencies.prompt: Check the dependencies for updates and known vulnerabilities, and say which ones matter.

changelog.name: Changelog draft
changelog.prompt: Draft release notes from the pull requests merged this week, grouped by area.

links.name: Docs link check
links.prompt: Find broken links in the docs and list the pages they are on.

review.name: Weekly review
review.prompt: Summarize what changed in the project this week and what is still open.

schedule.clockGap: The clocks skip this time; it runs at {{time}}.
schedule.clockOverlap: The clocks repeat this time; it runs once, at the first.
schedule.ranOnce: It ran on {{date}} at {{time}}, and will not run again.
schedule.onceOff: Turns itself off after it runs
schedule.cronSyntax: * any · a-b range · a,b list · */n every n · names like MON or JAN

problem.past: {{field}}: choose a time in the future.
problem.never: {{field}}: nothing matches in the next five years.
problem.frequent: {{field}}: runs must be at least 5 minutes apart.

schedule.unvalid: Not saved. The routine still runs on its last valid schedule: {{schedule}}
schedule.dstNote: Clocks moving for daylight saving shift a run by the hour, never skip it.
schedule.cronNote: Five fields, in your local time.

routine.name: Routine name

routine.agentDescription: The agent its runs start, with the model and options they use.
routine.permissionsHint: What its runs may do without asking
routine.timeLimitDescription: A run stops when it reaches this time, not counting the time it waits for you.

routine.keptConfirm_other: {{count}} older run sessions are removed. Their results stay in Runs.

routine.runsFailed: The runs could not be loaded.

routine.deleteWithSessions_one: Its {{count}} run session is deleted with it.

edit.name: Edit the project
edit.description: Also create, change, move and delete files inside the project folder.

commands.name: Edit and run commands
commands.description: Also run commands, which can do anything you can.

web.name: Use the web
web.description: Fetch pages and search the web, at any level.

caption.claude-code: Claude Code asks before edits and most commands, so Kettu answers each.
caption.codex: Codex keeps its own sandbox: Edit the project also runs commands inside the project without asking; leaving the project or reaching the network asks.
caption.opencode: OpenCode asks only for what its own permission settings mark “ask”; by default it asks nothing, so Kettu cannot hold it to this scope.
caption.pi: Pi does not ask before it acts, so Kettu cannot hold it to this scope.

run.skippedOverlap: Skipped: the last run was still working.
